from scipy.linalg import solve

 def __init__(self,s):

  self.qi=np.array([m.jnt_qposadr[m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] for i in range(21)])
  self.vi=np.array([m.jnt_dofadr[m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] for i in range(21)])
  self.ids=np.r_[np.arange(6),self.vi];self.n=len(self.ids)
  self.rest=d.qpos[self.qi].copy();self.rest[11:]=0;self.rest[[11,16]]=.2
  self.feet=np.array([self.foot(b)[0] for b in [6,11]])
  self.home=d.subtree_com[1].copy();self.home[2]=.98
  self.pelvisz=.98;self.prevJ={};self.prevA=None
  self.M=np.zeros((m.nv,m.nv));self.range=m.actuator_ctrlrange
 def foot(self,b):
  d=self.d;return d.xpos[b]+d.xmat[b].reshape(3,3)@np.array([.04,0,-.055]),d.xmat[b].reshape(3,3)
 def jac(self,b,p=None):
  jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jac(self.m,self.d,jp,jr,self.d.xpos[b] if p is None else p,b)
  return np.r_[jp[:,self.ids],jr[:,self.ids]]
 def action(self,com=None,feet=None,yaw=0,stance=(True,True),rest=None):
  m=self.m;d=self.d;n=self.n;v=d.qvel[self.ids]
  if com is None:com=self.home[:2]
  if feet is None:feet=self.feet
  if rest is None:rest=self.rest
  rows=[];ys=[]
  def add(key,J,e,kp,kd,w):
   vel=J@v
   jd=(J-self.prevJ.get(key,J))/.02@v;self.prevJ[key]=J.copy()
   rows.append(w*J);ys.append(w*(kp*np.asarray(e)-kd*vel-jd))
  R=Rotation.from_euler('z',yaw).as_matrix()
  J=self.jac(1)
  e=Rotation.from_matrix(R@d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
  add('pelz',J[2:3],[self.pelvisz-d.qpos[2]],100,20,5)
  add('pelrot',J[3:],e,100,20,5)
  jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv));mujoco.mj_jacSubtreeCom(m,d,jp,1)
  add('com',jp[:2,self.ids],np.asarray(com)-d.subtree_com[1,:2],50,14,5)
  contacts=[]
  for i,b in enumerate([6,11]):
   p,rot=self.foot(b);J=self.jac(b,p)

  dd=solve(A.T@A+np.eye(n)*.001,A.T@y,assume_a='pos',check_finite=False)

  if contacts:
   C=np.concatenate(contacts).T
   # minimum weighted wrench consistent with floating base equations
   weights=np.tile([1,1,1,.1,.1,.1],len(contacts))
   B=C[:6]*weights
